An '''Admurai fighter craft''' was a ship used in combat by the people of [[Adumar/Legends|Adumar]]. The craft was used in the [[Mission to Adumar|pursuit]] of [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Darth Caedus|Jacen Solo]] and his [[Padawan/Legends|apprentice]] [[Ben Skywalker]] after they spied on and retrieved video footage of an [[Dammant Killers|illegal weapons factory]] on Adumar.
